item.title: Robotic urbanization and embodied intelligence for cities
item.content:encoded:
Nature Cities, Published online: 07 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s44284-026-00536-7

Robots are becoming an increasingly visible presence in cities. This Perspective introduces the concept of robotic urbanization, examining how economic, social, infrastructural and governance forces shape the adoption of urban robots and influence the distribution of their benefits and impacts.
